entries.headline: Gulfstream FAZE31 reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported Gulfstream 5 registration 19-5591 using callsign FAZE31 and hex AE1436, attributing the sighting to reagan0965 and the photograph to CJMoeser via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Explosions near Strait of Hormuz and US military activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported heavy explosions in the southern Strait of Hormuz, US military transport aircraft active over the continental United States and coded US Air Force radio traffic.

entries.headline: Eastern Mediterranean activity reported near three times normal
entries.summary: War Watch reported military air activity in the Eastern Mediterranean at nearly three times its stated normal level, alongside multiple US transport aircraft over the United States.

entries.headline: Coded US Air Force broadcasts reported at nearly 3.6 times normal
entries.summary: War Watch reported coded US Air Force radio broadcasts at nearly 3.6 times its stated normal level across nine regions worldwide, spanning Korea to the North Sea, during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: US command aircraft, heavy transports and 14 coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a US Air Force nuclear command aircraft and multiple heavy transport aircraft over the United States, alongside 14 coded radio broadcasts during the day. The visible post is truncated after referring to the Gulf and Korea regions.

entries.headline: Coded US Air Force broadcasts reported at six times normal volume
entries.summary: War Watch reported US Air Force coded radio broadcasts at six times its stated normal volume across nine global regions, including the Middle East, Eastern Europe and Asia-Pacific.
